maddeler.e:
ألتهب (form VIII)
# أَلْتَهِبُ (ʔaltahibu) /ʔal.ta.hi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَبَ (iltahaba)
# أَلْتَهِبَ (ʔaltahiba) /ʔal.ta.hi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَهَبَ (iltahaba)
# أَلْتَهِبْ (ʔaltahib) /ʔal.ta.hib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِلْتَهَبَ (iltahaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
